title: Add launch-intent preview for operational capabilities
verified: launch.preview and capability.launch.preview generate typed intent.submit previews without creating PlanRun snapshots.
High-risk workflows render AgentCore planner, SecurityExecutionEngine, approval and rollback authority path.
Unsafe launch inputs fail closed before intent submission and do not create audit/run state.
Secret-like and secret:// launch inputs are redacted in deterministic preview output.
Command palette preview for launch.preview remains preview-before-dispatch.
risk_notes: Launch preview is a TUI projection path and does not call AgentCore accept_intent or plan_run.
TUI still does not own planner, resolver, policy or side-effect authority.
Parser-level and runtime-level validation reject shell-like launch input.
Explicit dispatch remains required after preview.
